knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

## Definición de fuentes de datos

El conjunto de datos utilizado se descargó desde Kaggle y contiene información sobre sueño, salud y estilo de vida de distintos individuos.

```{r cargar-datos, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Cargar librería
library(readr)

# Leer el archivo CSV (ajusta el nombre si lo cambiaste)
df <- read_csv("Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset.csv")
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df, aes(x = `Sleep Duration`)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribución de la duración del sueño",
       x = "Horas de sueño",
       y = "Frecuencia")
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
